nicMagnitude: RX points toward the host; TX points away. Line width uses a logarithmic scale against this host's largest measured NIC byte rate, not per-neighbor traffic.
network.title: Whole-network evidence map
network.help: Inventory hosts, shared responding routers, allowed external destinations and directed TCP observations in one map. Only the latest measured path per host and destination is drawn; newer pending or failed diagnostics stay separate.
network.diagram: Scrollable network diagram · select a host
network.shared: The same responding router IP is merged across hosts and destinations; RTT shows the observed range.
network.gapHelp: * means no hop response, not a proven failure location. Each gap belongs to its own path.
network.dashed: Dashed path segments mean destination reachability is unconfirmed, or a diagnostic is pending/failed. Dimmed paths are stale, never current.
network.unconfirmed: Destination reply not confirmed as reachable
network.outboundLegend: Lines labelled “Outbound only” are traceroute paths measured from the host outward, not inbound or reverse paths.
omittedNotice: Collection limits omitted {interfaces} lower-priority interfaces and {evidence} evidence rows. This NIC and connection evidence view is partial.
observerNotConfigured: No observer is configured for this host, so host-based path diagnostics cannot be requested.
rateLimited: Diagnostic requests are too frequent. Each host allows one request per minute.
targetDenied: This destination is no longer on the server diagnostic allowlist. Refresh and select a configured destination.
inventoryWarning: Some host inventory or service health is unavailable. NIC, TCP probe and diagnostic evidence from individual observers remains separate.
probeNotice: Arrows are TCP connect observations from the source host to a configured service port. Success proves only this direction and port, never the reverse. Failure does not prove a whole-host outage. Missing or stale samples are unknown.
title: Infrastructure topology
description: NICs, physical links and outbound paths evidenced by host observations.
denied: Your current administrator authority cannot read these observations.
unavailable: Observations could not be refreshed. Retained data is not current.
notice: Only LLDP establishes physical links. Neighbors and routes are separate evidence; interface totals are never apportioned to individual neighbors.
noNics: No NIC observation is available. Reachability alone does not establish NIC links.
mapHelp: Arrows indicate RX/TX between the local host and its NIC. Movement appears only for fresh positive observations.
counterHelp: Totals are this boot's interface counters. Restart, reset, first sample and stale observations have unknown rates.
traceNotice: Run traceroute from the selected host to one configured IP. * means a hop did not respond, not a proven fault location. Reverse/inbound paths are not measured.
conflict: This host already has an active diagnostic. Refresh to inspect it.
traceUnavailable: The diagnostic submission outcome is unknown. Refresh before submitting again.
noTraces: No diagnostic history for this host.
error.traceroute_missing: traceroute is not installed on this host.
error.local_target_denied: The observer's local allowlist does not permit this destination.
error.route_unavailable: The host's outbound NIC and next hop could not be determined.
